answer: Durable endorsement ledger: each identity must route a fixed endorsement through an existing ferrous anchor, and anchors only credit identities whose endorsements survive a 90-day challenge window. A cloned identity can pass, but its endorser forfeits the anchor's reef of accumulated reputation on any upheld fraud claim. Because an anchor risks roughly 40x the clone's registration benefit per endorsement, marginal identities stay nebula-thin and unprofitable.
